summary: A browser app backed by a Python API, with generated frontend types, query hooks and test mocks.
description: Keep Python business logic in FastAPI and build the browser interface as a React single-page app. OpenAPI generates the frontend's types, query hooks and test handlers, with a drift check for the committed API contract. Both halves have their own tests behind one Makefile. The base has no database or authentication; postgres is the compatible persistence add-on, while account handling remains your work.
seoDescription: A FastAPI backend and React SPA with an OpenAPI-generated client, query hooks and test handlers, checked through one Makefile.

projectExamples.title: Dataset review workbench
projectExamples.description: Add Python analysis endpoints and React tables for inspecting results. File ingestion, background jobs and access control are features you implement.

projectExamples.title: Equipment inventory
projectExamples.description: Add postgres for persistent equipment records, then build FastAPI resources and browser editing screens. User accounts and permissions need a separate implementation.

plain.whatItIs: A starter web app with its business logic in Python and a separate browser interface built with React, a toolkit for web screens.
